title: RealTimeMEVMonitor
tagline: Real-time MEV arbitrage monitor for DEX on Ethereum Mainnet
description: This project allows users to monitor on-chain MEV arbitrage behaviors in a real-time fashion. It is targeting multiple audiences. For example, DEX (Uniswap, 0X etc.) can use it to analyze their smart contract's vulnerabilities. Users such as retail investors can use our tool to steer clear of questionable tokens and be wary of unscrupulous arbitragers.
how_its_made: We developed a trace classifier that classifies transaction traces into sandwiches, arbitrages, swaps, etc. We built a end-to-end streaming application that broadcasts the classified transactions to end users. We use AWS as the cloud provider where we host our front end. This project leverages the highly performant Ethereum Mainnet archive node with trace enabled that is generously provided by QuickNode.
